title: Power series as the variables-adic completion of polynomials
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, sigma a finite type of variables, P=R[X_i : i in sigma] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and I the ideal generated by the X_i. There is a canonical P-algebra equivalence S:R[[T_i : i in sigma]] -> AdicCompletion I P [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series, def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. It sends a polynomial a to its canonical image in the completion, and the r-th component of S(F) is the class of the finite total-degree truncation of F at r. Empty variable types and r=0 are included.

proof.text: Use Mathlib MvPowerSeries.toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv sigma R for the equivalence. Its underlying map is toAdicCompletion by toAdicCompletionAlgEquiv_apply. The polynomial-image formula is toAdicCompletion_coe, and its component formula is toAdicCompletion_apply_eq_mk_truncTotal. These are exact Mathlib declarations, including the empty variable type and level zero.
